purposes.command.document.object.rig.edit: Edit a rig: bones, bindings and controls.

resourceBoundary.policy: Complete correlated retained receipt or typed refusal; no document or resource payload. Requests above 4096 encoded bytes are refused, never split.

semantics: Edit the native rig of a layer (draw, move and remove bones, influence radius, stroke binds, auto-assign, per-vertex weights, two-bone IK chains) as one sealed transaction per action, and reset or commit the pose as one reversible transaction each. #2255: the Alt-drag of a chain end is `dragIk` (the far end of a two-bone chain, solved toward a target: the chain is filed and the joint, the end and the coincident near vertex are written in one revision and one history entry). The live pose drag is a held `preview` of the existing rig view of query.document.object (a candidate rig answers every part, including the posed outlines of the bound strokes and meshes; nothing is published or kept), and the view carries the world map of a layer with Motion or a parent (`matrix`, the layer's own space to the world) instead of refusing it. A mesh bind is posed through the retained mesh store and the display rect of the raster that carries it on the layer's exposed frame; commit writes its posed offsets into the store with the stroke segments, and a mesh whose raster has no single rect is the typed pose_unavailable. No JS/Paper writer, no legacy fallback.
